description: This is a PHP source file for the metrics dashboard component of the TestLink open source testing management system. It generates a metrics dashboard table displaying test plan and platform metrics, including progress and status distribution, for the specified test project and user. The script includes functions for retrieving metrics data, configuring table columns, and initializing environment parameters, and it outputs HTML via Smarty templates.

classes.name: tlExtTable
classes.description: Class used to generate and manipulate external tables in the dashboard

classes.name: TLSmarty
classes.description: Class used for templating and rendering HTML pages

classes.name: testplan
classes.description: Class managing test plan operations, such as retrieving builds and platforms

classes.name: tlTestPlanMetrics
classes.description: Class responsible for calculating and managing test plan metrics

methods.name: getMetrics
methods.description: Retrieves test plan and platform metrics, returning data structures suitable for dashboard rendering

methods.name: getColumnsDefinition
methods.description: Computes column configuration for the metrics table based on visibility options and platform/data info

methods.name: collectTestProjectMetrics
methods.description: Aggregates overall test project progress and status metrics for display

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Verifies if the current user has rights to access test plan metrics
